subject: Request: Oxbridge Health case study quote + logo usage for GCP marketplace listing
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Riaz <sana@oxbridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Oxbridge Health case study quote + logo usage for GCP marketplace listing

Hi Sana —

Hope you’re doing well. We really appreciate how quickly Oxbridge ramped with our dedicated deployment last quarter — the performance and reliability feedback from your infra team was incredibly helpful.

We’re preparing a short customer spotlight for the GCP Marketplace listing (co-sell badge + listing quote) and wanted to check if Oxbridge would be open to: 1) a brief 1–2 sentence quote from a PM/engineering leader about value realized, and 2) permission to display Oxbridge’s logo on the Redwood listing and in a one-page case study.

We’ve drafted a 250–400 word case study that highlights the integration and cost/latency improvements; I’m attaching the draft and a suggested short quote for convenience. If you’re comfortable, we can route a DocuSign form for a quick logo/quote sign-off, or you can reply with approved text and the logo file you prefer we use.

High-level benefits we’d call out (for context):
- Reduced inference latency variability, enabling faster patient triage models
- Predictable monthly inference spend after migrating to Dedicated capacity
- Close collaboration on rollout and monitoring with your ML platform team

If you’d like to loop in legal or PR, please let us know who that should be and we’ll include them. No rush — if this is something you’re open to, could we aim to finalize by end of next week (Nov 29)?

Thanks again for being an early partner.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Strategic Account Exec | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0187

Attachment: oxbridge_case_study_draft.docx (word doc, 1 page draft)
From: Sana Riaz <sana@oxbridge.health>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: press@oxbridge.health
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:24:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Oxbridge Health case study quote + logo usage for GCP marketplace listing

Hi Kimberly —

Thank you — thrilled to hear the draft. We’re generally happy to participate and appreciate the concise approach. A couple of notes from our side:

- PR wants to review any public-facing language and the exact quote before sign-off. I’ve CC’d our PR mailbox (press@oxbridge.health) so they can triage.
- Legal will need to sign off on logo usage; their standard is a one-paragraph permission plus the brand asset guidelines PDF. I’ll get you the contact if we need a formal agreement.
- We prefer the quote to come from Victor Chen (Head of ML Ops). He’s travelling this week but can approve short text.

I reviewed the attached draft quickly — looks good overall. We’d ask to avoid publishing specific patient volume numbers (sensitive) and to keep the language focused on operational impact and developer velocity.

Happy to approve a short quote similar to: 
"Redwood’s Dedicated deployment helped us stabilize model latency and as a result speed our model iteration cycles."

If you can send a version with that line and the logo usage paragraph for legal, I’ll push both through PR/legal and loop Victor for the final sign-off.

— Sana
Sana Riaz
Director, Product Partnerships | Oxbridge Health
sana@oxbridge.health

Attachment: oxbridge_brand_guidelines.pdf (logo usage rules, page summary)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Oxbridge approval path — PR/legal checks + quote text (need quick internal ok)

Team — forwarding Sana’s reply. Oxbridge is willing but PR/legal want to review; Victor Chen (Head, ML Ops) will sign the quote.

Action items I’m asking we confirm internally: 
1) Slightly tighten the draft case study to remove any patient-volume or PII-adjacent metrics (Sana flagged this).
2) Approve the suggested short quote (one sentence) for GCP marketplace and co-sell badge.
3) Confirm the logo usage paragraph we’ll send to their legal matches our standard marketplace permission (I pasted our usual text below).

Proposed logo permission paragraph (to send to Oxbridge legal):
"Oxbridge Health grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the Oxbridge Health name and logo on Redwood marketing materials, partner listings (including cloud marketplace listings), and case studies for the purpose of promoting the partnership. Redwood agrees to comply with Oxbridge Health’s brand guidelines and will not alter the logo without prior consent."

Marissa — can you review the draft case study and remove the volume metric and any other PII?
Avery — do you have any legal redlines on the logo permission paragraph?
Dev — once we have final text and logo, can you coordinate with Marketplace ops to update the listing and add the co-sell quote?

Thanks — goal is to send Oxbridge a tidy package (updated draft, suggested short quote, logo usage paragraph, DocuSign if needed) by EOD tomorrow so they can route internally.

Best,
Kim

(see previous message)
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Oxbridge approval path — PR/legal checks + quote text (need quick internal ok)

Kim / team — quick read. I’m OK with the approach and the proposed logo permission paragraph with one edit: remove the phrase "non-transferable" (could be problematic in channel/reseller scenarios). Also we should explicitly limit the permission to marketing and marketplace channels for three years unless Oxbridge requests otherwise. Suggested replacement sentence: "Oxbridge Health grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive right to use the Oxbridge Health name and logo on Redwood marketing materials, partner listings (including cloud marketplace listings), and case studies for the purpose of promoting the partnership for a period of three years from the date of approval."

Marissa — please scrub the draft for PII and remove the patient-volume callout. Dev — we can instruct ops to stage the quote in a draft marketplace listing; do not publish until we have final sign-off from Oxbridge PR/legal.

Avery
Avery Johnson
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sana Riaz <sana@oxbridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, press@oxbridge.health
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Final: Draft case study + quote + logo permission (DocuSign link)

Hi Sana —

Thanks for the quick reply and for looping PR. Per your ask, we removed the patient-volume metric and focused the case study on operational impact. I’ve attached the updated one-page draft and included the short quote with Victor as the attributed author.

Per Oxbridge’s legal review, our counsel suggested a small change to the logo permission paragraph (see below) — we captured it in the DocuSign so legal can sign without back-and-forth if that helps. If you prefer to send a brand permission PDF instead, that’s fine too.

Updated logo permission paragraph (as in DocuSign):
"Oxbridge Health grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive right to use the Oxbridge Health name and logo on Redwood marketing materials, partner listings (including cloud marketplace listings), and case studies for the purpose of promoting the partnership for a period of three years from the date of approval. Redwood agrees to comply with Oxbridge Health’s brand guidelines and will not alter the logo without prior consent."

Links / attachments:
- Draft case study (attached): oxbridge_case_study_draft.docx
- Oxbridge logo stub (please upload the preferred file to the DocuSign or reply with the asset): oxbridge_logo.svg
- DocuSign sign-off link (if easier): https://www.docusign.com/signer-link/abc123

Would you like Victor’s quote to read exactly as we suggested, or will he provide a slightly different phrasing? If it’s easier, I can include both versions in the DocuSign and he can initial the preferred one.

Thanks again — we’ll hold the marketplace listing in draft until we have PR/legal sign-off from Oxbridge.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Strategic Account Exec | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
